reviews.title: Previous version of this game was AWESOME!
reviews.text:
Crossword critique
I’ve loved this game for a long time. I play it every day! For that reason, I am giving it four stars. But the reason I’m writing this review is because the recent update that was posted about a week ago has really made the game a lot less fun to play. It looks like the whole game was reprogrammed, but not for the better. I will try to explain why in detail, with hopes that this will be helpful and inspire some changes to make it more like the old game experience.

There used to be a satisfying rippling sound when you dragged your finger across the squares to select the next clue. Now it is silent. 

The celebration sound for getting the right answer is mistimed. It happens before the sound of placing the last letter when it should happen after this. The animation for placing the last letter is still happening as the celebration sound plays. This is a very jarring experience. It used to be perfectly timed. 

I don’t like the pig smiling sound happening every time you get a word. It’s too much. 

The pictures are smaller than they used to be. (There’s plenty of room for them to be bigger and easier to see!)

The graphics are cut off by the notch at the top of the screen on the iPhone. They used to flow around it. 

The text in the textual clues is bigger and in a different font than before. I liked the old font. 

The Bonus Coins animation (the one after certain games, where you randomly get 20, 30, 40, or 50 coins) moves too fast now and doesn’t have sound for each movement. It used to start fast then slow down and build suspense before revealing the selected bonus, with sound for each movement. The previous behaviour was much more satisfying. 

The “sign into Game Center” message comes up every time I launch the game. I don’t want to sign into Game Center. Please don’t show the message so often.

When solving a clue, the solution (ie the squares where you place the letters) seems to be smaller? It’s hard on the eyes. 

The cascading “bonus coins” that appear sometimes while playing a game seem to occur at arbitrary times and is just confusing. It seems to happen a lot; I’ve gotten it multiple times in one puzzle, again at random times. (Thanks for the coins though!)

The photo clues take much more time to load than they did previously. When you enter into a puzzle clue, there’s a blank white placeholder frame that sometimes takes a full second to be replaced by the photo clue. 

If I’m remembering correctly, the “Use Coins” button that comes up when you opt to buy a puzzle solution looks smaller than it used to be, and can be more difficult to hit than it used to be. 

The daily “roll for bonus coins” doesn’t make fun noises as it selects the amount anymore. Also the “CONTINUE” button is really tiny. Far too small. 

The “roll for today’s coins” doesn’t seem to be working properly. Sometimes it just doesn’t roll, instead it just shows the ad to purchase coins. When it does work, it’s always stuck on “day 1” even if it’s tapped two days in a row. I never get the Day 2, Day 3, etc behaviors.

Selecting the next word to guess isn’t as responsive as it used to be. You used to be able to select one immediately after solving a word, now it makes you wait for the animation to start and play for a moment before you can select a new word to solve.

Several places where the text size varies too much and looks distracting, where an element on the page has text either much bigger or much smaller than other elements on the page.

It looks like the latest update reset the achievements, so I’m getting free coins I don’t deserve, for things like “solve a daily puzzle” or “spend coins,” which I already got achievements for months ago

More annoyingly, the latest update seems to have locked all the puzzles I have paid to unlock in the past, and marked them as unplayed/uncompleted. I’ve paid coins to unlock about 15-20 of the puzzles, but after the latest update, all the puzzles are now locked except the five free puzzles (most of which I had completed, but are now showing 0%). 

I hope that these issues can be looked at, and would love it if the next update could either roll back to the last version of the game, or at the very least if the gameplay could be improved in each of the reported points. Thank you for your attention, and thank you for producing what used to be a wonderful game. It can be wonderful again! FOUR STARS! :)
